omapresent on Omarchy

Write a Markdown file, get a presentation, no slide design required.

Package data synced 2026-10-21 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install omapresent on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omapresent. It is a 1.1 MB download (1.9 MB installed), version 0.1.3-1, licensed MIT. Dead-simple, Markdown-only presentation app built with Qt Quick. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install omapresent on Omarchy

Omapresent turns any plain Markdown file into a slide deck automatically, treating the structure of your writing as the deck itself. It runs a dual-window mode with a separate editor and audience display, supports speaker notes only you can see, auto-tiles consecutive images into grids, embeds videos, and can export the result as a PDF or a static web bundle. It picks up your Omarchy desktop theme's colors automatically.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omapresent
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.1.3-1:
    pacman -Qi omapresent

Open and use omapresent

omapresent is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql omapresent | grep applications

omapresent requirements and compatibility

  • Qt6 (base, declarative, webengine, webchannel, multimedia)
  • xdg-desktop-portal

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omapresent on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omapresent. The download is 1.1 MB and it takes 1.9 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omapresent free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall omapresent?

Run omarchy pkg drop omapresent. It removes the package from your system.

What does omapresent depend on?

The package declares 8 dependencies: hicolor-icon-theme, qt6-base, qt6-declarative, qt6-webengine, qt6-webchannel, qt6-multimedia, xdg-desktop-portal, ttf-ia-writer. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omapresent a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for omapresent.

Is omapresent in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omapresent (version 0.1.3-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Jethro Jones makes it. Project site: https://github.com/jethrojones/omapresent.
